verdict: C1 — the disc's bending under the bark's bearing force turns the collar's foot. The slope is driven by a bearing, so of `105`'s cycle readings two apply: without a preload (one-sided) and on a preload at least the force (unbounded in the tree); the reversed reading is a tie's. At the ratified wall 0.28 mm the worst cell — b zone3 fit · anode bond stiff · state2 rigid bark · upper whisker · rim only dished seat, F_F 673 N, on the «grooved + root» plate — carries σ_n 106.8 MPa with the collar's foot coupled to the disc (116.9 following it, the upper bound): without a preload it holds SF 2 up to K_f 1.37 on `55`'s as-built SLM marker and 2.35 on its wrought marker (following: 1.25 ⊥ 2.15); on a preload ≥ F the same numbers are its unnotched SF, so on the as-built marker it holds SF 2 there at no K_f, and the SLM + HIP route, whose endurance the tree has no marker for, holds it unnotched only with an endurance of at least 282 MPa (0.33 σ_y; 319 following). On `105`'s uniform plate the same cell holds SF 2 without a preload up to K_f 2.33 on the as-built marker: the shortfall is the grooved plate's — the O-ring groove turns the free plate ×1.60 at the collar (applied geometry; Kirchhoff across a step about 1.4 thicknesses wide), O'Donnell's root ×1.12 on top (a reading) and a root twice as compliant ×1.08 more. Over the walls where the collar's coupling K_c·C_d stays ≤ 0.3 (0.2, 0.28, 0.3, 0.5 mm) the coupled one-sided K_f on the as-built marker is flat, 1.36–1.41; above, it rises only through that one-degree-of-freedom coupling (K_c·C_d 1.16 at 1 mm) while following the disc it falls, so the 0.28 mm numbers do not transfer to a thicker wall. C2 — the capsule's inertia and drag put at most 0.34 N on a lug (all on one). C3 — the same bending moves the rim seat against the collar's foot by up to 11.1 µm at `105`'s largest force, so the deflection-controlled loop swings the clamp by k × that, shared by the 3 lugs: at most 1.44–111 N on a lug over `89`'s grid of k (0.3–30 N/µm, which nothing in the tree pins); a compliant element in the loop (`89`'s force-controlled branch) would cut it, at `89`'s named price — the rim's margin against tipping, which hands the lateral loads to C4. The lug root's MEAN is the clamp's eccentric load: at 0.28 mm with the lug engaged 1.3 mm a newton on one lug bends the wall's foot by 8.6 MPa (45° spread) to 20.2 MPa (strip), so `89`'s lowest clamp (force-controlled, 120 N over 3 lugs) already gives 347–811 MPa (0.39–0.92 of the yield) and the PEEK-dominated loop's lower bound at the window top (632 N) at least 1820–4246 MPa — neither reading is a bound, `73`'s pure shear, on which the ratified wall stands, does not see this bending, and the lug root is undecidable, statically and in fatigue, until the wall under a lug is a shell model (`89` path 4).
